sn35.154:1.1: kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pe || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || Indriyasampanno indriyasampanno ti vuccati || kittāvatā nu kho bhante indriyasampanno hotīti || ||
sn35.154:2.1: Cakkhundriye ce bhikkhu udayavyayānupassī viharanto cakkhundriye nibbindati || Sotindriye || Ghānindriye || Jivhindriye || Kāyindriye || Manindriye ce bhikkhu udayavyayānupassī viharanto manindriye nibbindati || nibbindaṃ virajjati || la || Vimutasmi vimuttamhīti ñānaṃ hoti || Khīnā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ || kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānāti || || Ettāvatā kho bhikkhu indriyasampannoti || || Atha
